notes: Duplicates: 'same footage' is much stricter. Different minutes of a fixed camera (security, dash or trail cams) were grouped as copies because the small fingerprint can't tell them apart. Possible matches are now checked more closely - what moves between frames, and sharper pictures that catch a changed on-screen clock or a small object - so only real re-encoded or resized copies match.
Duplicates: no more chains - every copy in a set must match the copy that is kept (before, A like B and B like C put A, B and C together, which made sets of 40+).

Duplicates: new option 'Never match recordings whose names show different times' (on): camera files named by their recording time are never treated as copies of each other. Identical files are still found.
